title: Item back in store
description: Tell customers a requested item is available again at their local store. Back in stock WhatsApp template for physical retail.
notes: Name the specific item and store; generic restock notes get low engagement. Only send to people who requested the alert.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, the *{{product_name}}* you asked about is back in stock at {{store_name}}. We can set one aside for you.
